requiredConsumerBehavior: Read canonical knowledge from Librarium records.
Request generated runtime views instead of parsing raw evidence archives.
Preserve evidence state and provenance in debug/validation output.

notes: This contract is intentionally implementation-neutral so Codex can adapt existing repo code without changing the canonical architecture.
